# apis

Types from PocketBase's Go package `apis`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [apis](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/apis).

## apis.CORSConfig

CORSConfig defines the config for CORS middleware.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `allowOrigins` | <code>Array&lt;string&gt;</code> | AllowOrigins determines the value of the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header. This header defines a list of origins that may access the resource. |
| `allowOriginFunc` | <code>(origin: string) =&gt; boolean</code> | AllowOriginFunc is a custom function to validate the origin. It takes the origin as an argument and returns true if allowed or false otherwise. If an error is returned, it is returned by the handler. If this option is set, AllowOrigins is ignored. |
| `allowMethods` | <code>Array&lt;string&gt;</code> | AllowMethods determines the value of the Access-Control-Allow-Methods response header. This header specified the list of methods allowed when accessing the resource. This is used in response to a preflight request. |
| `allowHeaders` | <code>Array&lt;string&gt;</code> | AllowHeaders determines the value of the Access-Control-Allow-Headers response header. This header is used in response to a preflight request to indicate which HTTP headers can be used when making the actual request. |
| `allowCredentials` | <code>boolean</code> | AllowCredentials determines the value of the Access-Control-Allow-Credentials response header. This header indicates whether or not the response to the request can be exposed when the credentials mode (Request.credentials) is true. When used as part of a response to a preflight request, this indicates whether or not the actual request can be made using credentials. See also [MDN: Access-Control-Allow-Credentials]. |
| `unsafeWildcardOriginWithAllowCredentials` | <code>boolean</code> | UnsafeWildcardOriginWithAllowCredentials UNSAFE/INSECURE: allows wildcard '*' origin to be used with AllowCredentials flag. In that case we consider any origin allowed and send it back to the client with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header. |
| `exposeHeaders` | <code>Array&lt;string&gt;</code> | ExposeHeaders determines the value of Access-Control-Expose-Headers, which defines a list of headers that clients are allowed to access. |
| `maxAge` | <code>number</code> | MaxAge determines the value of the Access-Control-Max-Age response header. This header indicates how long (in seconds) the results of a preflight request can be cached. The header is set only if MaxAge != 0, negative value sends "0" which instructs browsers not to cache that response. |

## apis.GzipConfig

GzipConfig defines the config for Gzip middleware.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `level` | <code>number</code> | Gzip compression level. Optional. Default value -1. |
| `minLength` | <code>number</code> | Length threshold before gzip compression is applied. Optional. Default value 0. |

## apis.ServeConfig

ServeConfig defines a configuration struct for apis.Serve().

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `showStartBanner` | <code>boolean</code> | ShowStartBanner indicates whether to show or hide the server start console message. |
| `httpAddr` | <code>string</code> | HttpAddr is the TCP address to listen for the HTTP server (eg. "127.0.0.1:80"). |
| `httpsAddr` | <code>string</code> | HttpsAddr is the TCP address to listen for the HTTPS server (eg. "127.0.0.1:443"). |
| `certificateDomains` | <code>Array&lt;string&gt;</code> | Optional domains list to use when issuing the TLS certificate. |
| `allowedOrigins` | <code>Array&lt;string&gt;</code> | AllowedOrigins is an optional list of CORS origins (default to "*"). |
